newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac will reduce mortgage rate.
newsitem.headline: Westpac will reduce mortgage rate.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp said on Wednesday it would cut its variable mortgage rate by 50 basis points to 8.75 percent.
All four of Australia's major banks have now cut their key mortgage rates in response to the reduction in official interest rates by the Reserve Bank of Australia on Wednesday morning.
The other major banks, National Australia Bank Ltd, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, and Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, have cut their standard variable mortgage rates to 8.75 percent.
The RBA, citing low inflation and the need to speed up economic growth, reduced the official cash rate to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.
